olm_pc_gaba_tau.label: OLM→PYR GABA decay time constant (ms)
olm_pc_gaba_tau.desc: Inhibitory synapse kinetics: longer decay → slower theta, stronger PAC.

olm_pc_conprob.label: OLM→PYR connection probability
olm_pc_conprob.desc: Higher → stronger OLM drive on PYR distal dendrites → more robust theta-gamma PAC.

olm2pcDep.label: OLM→PYR short-term depression time constant (ms)
olm2pcDep.desc: Higher D → deeper depression → PYR escapes inhibition faster → theta may speed up.

olm2pcFac.label: OLM→PYR short-term facilitation time constant (ms)
olm2pcFac.desc: Higher → stronger later IPSPs on PYR → may slow theta and increase gamma synchrony.

pc_olm_conprob.label: PYR→OLM connection probability
pc_olm_conprob.desc: Excitatory feedback: most direct lever on the OLM-PYR feedback loop and PAC.

pv_pc_conprob.label: PVBC→PYR connection probability
pv_pc_conprob.desc: Perisomatic inhibition: higher → cleaner, stronger gamma oscillations.

pvbc2pcDep.label: PVBC→PYR STP depression time constant (ms)
pvbc2pcDep.desc: Higher D → longer inhibitory window per gamma cycle → lower gamma frequency.

pc_pv_conprob.label: PYR→PVBC connection probability
pc_pv_conprob.desc: Excitatory drive to fast interneurons: higher → stronger PING gamma.

pc_pc_conprob.label: PYR→PYR recurrent connection probability
pc_pc_conprob.desc: Recurrent excitation: illustrates E-I balance; too high → runaway activity.

artifperpyr.label: Number of SC input fibers per PYR cell (SCIL proxy)
artifperpyr.desc: Main control of the operating point. PAC emerges roughly between 60-110.
